snippet.title: Mathc! The 12 Cz Wars
snippet.description: My independently developed game, "Match!12CZ Wars" is a casual strategy game centered around match-3 gameplay, blended with tower-climbing deckbuilding and roguelite elements. In the game, players will form a team of three from twelve Chinese zodiac-inspired Divine Maidens to cleanse the village of nearby monsters and spirits. Along the journey, a wide variety of random events await discovery.
